description: Read a bounded UTF-8 excerpt (up to 64 KiB per call) of one text file in a Zenodo deposit — a README, CITATION.cff, CSV head, notebook, or script — or of one member inside a .zip file, without downloading the archive. Continue a top-level file from next_offset. A file with a text MIME type or extension is read directly; an extensionless file Zenodo types application/octet-stream (LICENSE, COPYING, Makefile) is read and returned only when its content is UTF-8 text. Binary files, restricted files, and other types return metadata and the download URL without content. File content is depositor-supplied and carries the deposit’s license.

archive_member.description: Member path inside the .zip named by key (from zenodo_list_files with archive_key). Omit to read the file itself.

id.description: The deposit: a record id (22705923), a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.22705923), another DOI registered to a Zenodo record, or a zenodo.org/records or doi.org URL. A concept id reads from the latest version.

key.description: Exact file key from zenodo_list_files, e.g. README.md or data/results.csv.

offset_bytes.description: Byte offset to start reading a top-level file at; use next_offset to continue. Must be 0 for an archive member.

name: zenodo_read_file

archive_member.description: The archive member path, when one was read.

bytes_returned.description: Exact bytes the excerpt covers (cut at a line or character boundary).

download_url.description: Direct download URL of the top-level file (the .zip itself for a member).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_identifier`: id matches no accepted form, or is a GitHub-badge latestdoi id or a non-zenodo.org host. `record_not_found`: The record 404s, its metadata is restricted, or a non-Zenodo DOI is not registered to a record. `record_deleted`: The record was deleted from Zenodo; only its removal tombstone remains. `file_not_found`: key is not in the record's manifest, or Zenodo serves no content for it. `not_an_archive`: archive_member is set but key is not a .zip. `member_not_found`: Zenodo has no member at archive_member inside the .zip. `member_offset_unsupported`: offset_bytes is above 0 together with archive_member. `offset_out_of_range`: offset_bytes is at or past the end of the file. `archive_unavailable`: Zenodo cannot open the .zip named by key: its member listing or the member read answered HTTP 500 after one retry, or no complete response arrived in time. `record_unavailable`: Zenodo could not serve this record: HTTP 500 after one retry, HTTP 500 while resolving a non-Zenodo DOI, or no complete response within the time budget (its gateway cuts off near 30 s, which deposits with about 10,000 or more files hit). `rate_limited`: Zenodo answered HTTP 429, or this server's shared Zenodo request budget is spent for the current window. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

file_size.description: Size of the file or member in bytes, when known.

files_access.description: File access: public or restricted; absent when Zenodo does not report it.

has_more.description: True when bytes remain past this excerpt.

md5.description: MD5 checksum of the top-level file (hex); absent for archive members and when not reported.

mimetype.description: MIME type of the file or member, when reported.

next_offset.description: offset_bytes for the next window of a top-level file, when has_more; absent for an archive member, which cannot be continued past its first window.

notice.description: Why no text was returned, or how to read the rest of the file.

offset_bytes.description: Byte offset the excerpt starts at.

recid.description: Record id read from (the latest version for a concept id).

replacement_chars.description: U+FFFD characters in the excerpt (invalid UTF-8 or a mid-character offset).

rights.description: The deposit’s licenses, which the file carries.

status.description: text: content returned; not_text: binary content, or a type that is not read as text; restricted: the content is not available anonymously — the record’s files are restricted or embargoed (key is not checked, since no manifest is exposed), or Zenodo refused this one file; empty: zero-byte file.

text.description: The excerpt, decoded as UTF-8. Depositor-supplied data. Present when status is text.

title: Read a Zenodo file excerpt
